//: Things no netlist format records. Written by spark init from the nets in the built design; every value is null until someone establishes it.
//i2c_buses: Where an I2C bus is, as a net name or as Component.PIN. Seeded from the part records: a line is here when a module needs THIS board to pull it up. Add or remove as the design actually is.
//must_not_float: Pins that must never be left floating, as ["Component", "PIN"] pairs. An H-bridge input is the usual one: floating, it can turn both halves on. Seeded from every pin the design's own part records declare as an input — an empty list means the records declare none, not that nobody filled it in.
//pulled_by_firmware: Inputs the board's internal pull-up holds, set by the firmware with Pin.PULL_UP, so no resistor is on the board (P204). No netlist shows it, so check_all says it on a ? line.

physics.//trace_temperature_rise_c: How much warmer a trace may run than ambient. 10 is the usual conservative choice and is a DECISION, not a measurement — change it deliberately.
physics.//i2c_bus_capacitance_pf: Total bus capacitance: cable, fan-out and every device pin. Decides whether the pull-ups are strong enough for the clock you chose.

//fabrication: What YOUR board house can make, by the names in the plugin's data/fabrication.json — min_annular_ring_mm, min_via_hole_mm, min_via_pad_mm, board_thickness_mm, copper_thickness_mm and the rest. Empty means the plugin's defaults for a cheap two-layer process. Stating one moves both the check and the generator that draws for it, because they read the same number.
